theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_projection_net
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ (N : ℕ) (T : Fin N → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ j, Module.finrank ℝ (T j) = n) ∧ ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → ∃ j, ‖Q.starProjection - (T j).starProjection‖ < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
